markers.name: ANC_01_NOTICES_CHANGE
markers.note: He notices the beauty and danger of early industrial change.

markers.name: ANC_02_MENDS_SLEEVE
markers.note: He helps mend a stranger's sleeve.

markers.name: ANC_03_COAT_CATCHES
markers.note: He receives help when his own coat catches on a nail.

markers.name: ANC_04_WATCHES_ASK
markers.note: He watches a worker ask for assistance.

markers.name: ANC_05_FOLLOWS_MELODY
markers.note: He follows the melody instead of stopping.

markers.name: ANC_06_PRESERVES_THROUGH_CALL
markers.note: He preserves voices and images while someone calls him to dinner.

markers.name: ANC_07_CANNOT_TELL_TRUE
markers.note: He becomes unable to tell Oino which recording is true.

markers.name: ANC_08_ZONE_EXIT_NO_CERTAINTY
markers.note: He stands at the Zone exit and offers no certainty.

markers.name: CLIP_ANC_CAMERA_DINNER_END
markers.note: Clip ends; still no dinner answer
